results.name: Belton_Parcels
results.title: Belton Parcels
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides parcel boundary and property record information for the Belton area in Cass County. It supports access to mapped land parcels with associated assessor and property attributes used for property management, taxation, and local land records.

Layer Contents
  • Belton_Parcels: Parcel polygons with property identifiers, ownership and mailing details, land area, valuation, sale date, subdivision and legal reference information, and service district or taxing information.
Geographic Coverage

The layer covers the Belton area within Cass County, Missouri, supporting local parcel reference and property record workflows.

Use Cases
  • Property lookup and parcel reference
  • Tax assessment and valuation review
  • Land records and ownership research
  • Planning, permitting, and jurisdictional analysis
  • Assessor and county GIS applications
results.snippet: Parcel data for Belton in Cass County, Missouri, with property and assessor attributes for local land records and tax-related workflows.

results.title: Parcels, Compiled from Opt-In Open Data Counties, Minnesota
results.description:
This dataset is a compilation of county parcel data from Minnesota counties that have opted-in for their parcel data to be included in this dataset. It includes the following 59 counties that have opted-in as of the publication date of this dataset: Aitkin County, Anoka County, Becker County, Benton County, Big Stone County, Carlton County, Carver County, Cass County, Chippewa County, Chisago County, Clay County, Clearwater County, Cook County, Crow Wing County, Dakota County, Douglas County, Fillmore County, Grant County, Hennepin County, Houston County, Isanti County, Itasca County, Jackson County, Koochiching County, Lac qui Parle County, Lake County, Lake of the Woods County, Lyon County, Marshall County, McLeod County, Mille Lacs County, Morrison County, Mower County, Murray County, Norman County, Olmsted County, Otter Tail County, Pennington County, Pipestone County, Polk County, Pope County, Ramsey County, Red Lake County, Renville County, Rice County, Scott County, Sherburne County, St. Louis County, Stearns County, Steele County, Stevens County, Traverse County, Wabasha County, Waseca County, Washington County, Wilkin County, Winona County, Wright County, and Yellow Medicine County. If you represent a county not included in this dataset and would like to opt-in, please contact Heather Albrecht (Heather.Albrecht@hennepin.us), co-chair of the Minnesota Geospatial Advisory Council (GAC)’s Parcels and Land Records Committee's Open Data Subcommittee. County parcel data does not need to be in the GAC parcel data standard to be included. MnGeo will map the county fields to the GAC standard. County parcel data records have been assembled into a single dataset with a common coordinate system (UTM Zone 15) and common attribute schema. The county parcel data attributes have been mapped to the GAC parcel data standard for Minnesota: https://www.mngeo.state.mn.us/committee/standards/parcel_attrib/parcel_attrib.html This compiled parcel dataset was created using Python code developed by Minnesota state agency GIS professionals, and represents a best effort to map individual county source file attributes into the common attribute schema of the GAC parcel data standard. The attributes from counties are mapped to the most appropriate destination column. In some cases, the county source files included attributes that were not mapped to the GAC standard. Additionally, some county attribute fields were parsed and mapped to multiple GAC standard fields, such as a single line address. Each quarter, MnGeo provides a text file to counties that shows how county fields are mapped to the GAC standard. Additionally, this text file shows the fields that are not mapped to the standard and those that are parsed. If a county shares changes to how their data should be mapped, MnGeo updates the compilation. If you represent a county and would like to update how MnGeo is mapping your county attribute fields to this compiled dataset, please contact us. This dataset is a snapshot of parcel data, and the source date of the county data may vary. Users should consult County websites to see the most up-to-date and complete parcel data. There have been recent changes in date/time fields, and their processing, introduced by our software vendor. In some cases, this has resulted in date fields being empty. We are aware of the issue and are working to correct it for future parcel data releases. The State of Minnesota makes no representation or warranties, express or implied, with respect to the use or reuse of data provided herewith, regardless of its format or the means of its transmission. THE DATA IS PROVIDED “AS IS” WITH NO GUARANTEE OR REPRESENTATION ABOUT THE ACCURACY, CURRENCY, SUITABILITY, PERFORMANCE, MECHANTABILITY, RELIABILITY OR FITINESS OF THIS DATA FOR ANY PARTICULAR PURPOSE. This dataset is NOT suitable for accurate boundary determination. Contact a licensed land surveyor if you have questions about boundary determinations. DOWNLOAD NOTES: This dataset is only provided in Esri File Geodatabase and OGC GeoPackage formats. A shapefile is not available because the size of the dataset exceeds the limit for that format. The distribution version of the fgdb is compressed to help reduce the data footprint. QGIS users should consider using the Geopackage format for better results.As of 09/02/2026, updates were made to fix standardization issues with St. Louis County state pin field and Murray County owner name field.

results.name: Central_Square_Map
results.title: Central Square Municipal GIS Layers
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides a municipal geographic information system for the Central Square area, combining core street, address, parcel, building, land use, zoning, and boundary datasets with selected transportation and hazard layers. It supports local planning, asset management, public works, and map-based reference across the community.

Feature Layers
  • Address Points: Point locations for site addresses, including address components and stewardship information used for geocoding and location reference.
  • Streets: Street centerline data with route, jurisdiction, speed limit, lane, travel direction, and route designation attributes for transportation and network mapping.
  • Railroads: Railroad line features for transportation and infrastructure context.
  • Parcels: Property boundary polygons with parcel identification, ownership, mailing, tax, valuation, acreage, and utility district information.
  • Building Footprints: Building outline polygons with address reference and edit tracking fields for structure inventory and mapping.
  • Belton Lots: Lot boundary polygons used for local land and property reference.
  • Overlay Districts: Special district polygons for Old Town Belton and North Scott, supporting downtown and corridor planning.
  • Flood Insurance Rate Map 2016: Flood zone polygons used for floodplain reference and risk awareness.
  • Zoning: Zoning polygons with zone names and descriptions linked to parcel information for land use regulation and planning review.
  • Subdivisions: Subdivision boundaries for neighborhood and development reference.
  • PLSS Sections Cass County: Public Land Survey System section boundaries for land description and reference.
  • Belton Boundary: Municipal boundary polygon with area information for city extent reference.
Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Central Square and Belton area in Cass County, Missouri, with layers that support citywide reference and local jurisdictional mapping.

Use Cases
  • Property and parcel lookup
  • Address and geocoding reference
  • Zoning and land use review
  • Transportation and roadway planning
  • Floodplain and hazard awareness
  • Municipal boundary and subdivision reference
  • Building and infrastructure inventory
results.snippet: A municipal GIS service for the Central Square and Belton area in Cass County, Missouri, including parcels, addresses, streets, zoning, buildings, flood zones, railroads, and boundary layers.

results.snippet: Parcel data has been identified as a foundational data layer for Minnesota and provides benefits for many operational uses. This dataset enables users to visualize the government owned parcels within each opt-in open county. It provides a best-effort inference of government ownership based on attributes provided by counties (often owner name, taxpayer name, or use class) where the ownership was not directly provided. This dataset was developed to enable geospatial professionals to perform statewide geospatial analysis, research, and mapping. For instance, knowing where government units have land holdings will help with coordinating land management and conservation efforts across Minnesota. The dataset provides a subset of the parcels from opt-in, open data counties, in a common coordinate system. Users can join this dataset to the open parcel dataset using the objectid field to access parcel attributes in the standard GAC schema.

results.title: 2626_baltimore_ave
results.description:
CountyParcels_DLGF_RESTRICTED is an enhanced version of County Parcel data collected from each of the 92 counties in Indiana as part of the Indiana Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI). These data include the parcel features and attributes from assessment data provided to the Department of Local Government and Finance. Please note, there may be records with duplicate parcel IDs. That will result in the DLGF information being duplicated for each record. The owner, class code, etc. will still be correct, but the value and deeded acreage fields will be for the sum of the matched numbers, not the individual polygons. IMPORTANT: All records in this dataset are completely replaced with each update. Therefore, using the "Create Layer from Selected Features" in ArcMap will not work correctly after the proceeding update, nor will definition queries based on OBJECTID.

Latest update: 11/7/2019 with 2019 polygons (GIO.COUNTY_Parcel) and 2018 pay 2019 DLGF information.

results.title: CASS_PARCELS
results.snippet:
This dataset was acquired from Cass CAD's vendor Harris Govern for distribution in the TNRIS DataHub as part of the annually updated statewide land parcel program.  Visit the website for current details, program progress, and FAQs https://tnris.org/stratmap/land-parcels/

TNRIS compiled existing parcel data and transformed it into a common schema via translation tools for ease of use statewide.  When applicable, some fields were concatenated or calculated.  Null or empty values denote absence of data in the provided request.  Geometry was not edited nor will be in the future by TNRIS.  Please contact the CAD or their vendor for more information that is outside of the scope of this dataset or program.

The enclosed csv/xml file documents data mappings used in the conversion from the source data into the common schema.  This denotes the source field names that were translated into the common schema fields.

Field descriptions are taken from industry standards and supplemented by TNRIS.
